headline: China targets 9,800 EFLOPS by 2030; Mistral raises €3B
body: Compute was the theme. China's industry ministry set a 2030 target of 9,800 EFLOPS of AI computing, over four times today's capacity, with 3.8 trillion yuan of infrastructure investment. That pushes Capability Velocity, lifting Descendants, Protector God and Enslaved God and weighing on Reversion. Mistral's €3 billion round, led by Samsung, strengthens a European challenger and eases Power Concentration, helping Libertarian Utopia and trimming Benevolent Dictator. A US loan to restart an Iowa nuclear plant for Google's AI power added capability; a WIRED report on Meta running AI child-abuse ads added Tech Backlash. Horizon Balance edged up to -2.97.
movers_note: Descendants +0.3, from China's compute target (+0.34) and the Iowa nuclear loan (+0.04), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.07). Reversion -0.3, from China's compute target (-0.34) and the Iowa nuclear loan (-0.04), partly offset by the Meta abuse-ads order (+0.07) and smaller items (+0.03). Conquerors +0.3, from China's compute target (+0.28) and the Iowa nuclear loan (+0.03), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.06).
